devNotes.content: # Day 1 of Learning Web Design by Aman Sir **Learnings of the Day** How the era of Internet evolved and how the things changed with time, how the web changed and how people started believing on design and styles which they created by their own and followed the trends. [**ASSIGNMENT**](https://www.figma.com/board/pbMLQVa1v00bweHkSHikP8/Immersive-Web-Design?node-id=0-1&t=RdpkE6GMgxBYOiUw-1) ## You can find the assignment by clicking on above link, please don't edit :/

# HMM this can be much better, didn't enjoyed it!




















Read more **Hehe, I got your attention ><** I mean, the internet was bron with almost zero sense of design or at least not in the way we deifne it today. The people buliding the early web weren't follwosing design systems, UX principles, or trying to maximize 🤝🏻 CONVERSION RATES. They were experimentinG while being curious, But are creative. Today, we look back at many of those websites and casually call them ugly. But what does ugly actually mean? I think Ugly doesn't always mean bad looking or weird. Sometimes it simply means different and different from what we have accepted a "good design." Today's task of making an ugly webpage, it sounded easy at first. But the more I thought about it, it was not easy? or is it? coz we were thinking and taking certain decison to make it ugly. Even an "ugly" website is designed in its own way. And that's where it becomes subjective. A website that Aditi, Anchit, or Darshan made might look beautiful to Sanskar, but to me it's ugly. No one of us is right or wrong. I think it's just a part of what is "GOOD Design" in our dictionary. Maybe "UGLY" isn't a design at all or MAYBE it's just a label we have given to something that is not as per our expectations. I'm honestly surprised you are reading till here. These are just my thoughts, and I could be completely wrong, but that's what made today's assignment interesting for me.

SPEECHLESS,

The day went with full headache that I am not in a state to write anything, but still lemme try.


Learning flex was really cool, as it unlocked the way responsive sites work and how sections could be responsive.
I can't sleep for next 2 days thinking about how the complex, CRM softwares are coded and what their developers are eating.
Playing with CSS was also a fun initially but now it's more fun as we are going further and can imagine what crazy things can be done.
I am in a deep thought, especially when he said the "Rebeccapurple" is given for the person who is working in CSS in his daughter's memory, it's so cool.
Like in a day if we are learning 20+ new css properties, so how many are there? Are there 1000s? if yes then I would like to explore them, because I want my websites to be Flowing like a "River" and should have highest "CONVERSION RATE".

Thanks!

# is this happening fr?

Hello. So, it was a long day today. Initially, I thought it's going to be too easy with GSAP. Like I just had to animate from point A to point B to point C and point D, somewhere like that. But as I was going further ahead, I got to know that this is not easy. It's a mess. It's a fucking mess. And yeah, it took almost a day to do this kind of shit. Like I started with basic placement of images. I did it. And after doing the placement, I found that transparent images are still images. So we cannot have this hover kind of thing with transparent images. So to figure that out, I had to add the hotspots. So basically, hotspots are the locations where we can just hover. And hotspots can be like manually set so that only that area will be triggered on hover. So I did that. I figured that out, like how I can make the hover animation possible with transparent images. So I did that. After doing that, my next goal was to adding the timeline to my overall scene. Like I just wanted, like there are six buildings, so I wanted it to be zoomed at first scroll to the first building, ground floor. Then on the next scroll, it should go to the right. Then on the next scroll, it should go to the third building balcony. Then on the next, it should go below that balcony, like the bottom floor, and so on and so on. So as I planned, I thought it's going to be too easy. But again, mapping the camera movement in GSAP is a headache. And yeah, it was too crazy tough. It was again too many iterations with here and there. I tried using LLM, but it was not helping. I tried understanding the syntax. I tried figuring out the things. Like some things I did manually, some things I did with GPT. Then somehow things worked at 10 p.m. night. And after that, the next challenge was to add the buttons. So my images were looking good, timeline was working with animations, but when I was trying to add the buttons, again, it's not easy and I'm still doing it. I will do it tomorrow. That's it for today. It was a whole fucking crazy day, but I enjoyed this shit. Yeah.


![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/17f58ac7-829e-461d-91e3-7ad436d48dd1)

# Hmm, life's good. 

Today was no progress day. Like, sometimes what we get very ambitious for is not something which is really meant for us. So it's better to stick with something which is really meant for us. 
This one thing taught me a lot today. Initially, I was thinking like creating animation with a scroll will be a best choice. 
As I stick with it, it's not done, but it's working fine. Later, I thought let's add the Me card thing. So I was figuring out how I can put the Obsidian thing with overall Me card pages so that whatever I will put in Obsidian, it will get reflected on my Me card. Whether it's poems, whether it's personal things, whether it's scripts, articles, or whatever it is. So that is something I was looking for, and it's quite interesting stuff to do. I am just worried about designing each page UI. So right now I'm on it, like half of the day I spent just to fix one single bug on my side to make the buttons responsive with the size of the overall canvas. It was not possible at all. So I figured out a way that how I can bake the buttons inside my illustration and just make them clickable. So I did that only. 
And no big update so far. What I'm planning tomorrow is, let's finish the rest of the pages design and implement it on the website as soon as possible. 

Rest, the day was really good. It was really a fun today. We enjoyed a lot. We also got some crazy gifts from Prabhu sir today. Like we, just three were there in the studio. So Anchita, I, and Darshan, we got gifts from Prabhu sir. So it was a crazy day today. And, and, and, we enjoyed this day. But not big progress today. I think the holiday is something which was really getting over everything. Yeah, that's it.

Byeee, peace off!
